elements.element: The obligations apply upon expiry or termination of the agreement.
elements.evidence: The clause applies “[u]pon expiry or termination of this Agreement for any reason.”

elements.element: Vendor must provide transition assistance to Customer.
elements.evidence: HDI must “provide the Company with transition assistance.”

elements.element: Transition assistance must be available for up to six months.
elements.evidence: The assistance is required “for up to six (6) months.”

elements.element: Transition assistance must be provided at Vendor's then-current rates.
elements.evidence: The clause specifies “at HDI's then-current rates.”

elements.element: Vendor must return Customer Data to Customer.
elements.evidence: HDI must return to the Company “all Content, user information and other data belonging to, supplied by or processed for the Company,” which substantively covers Customer Data.

elements.element: Vendor must return Customer Data within 30 days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: Return is required “within thirty (30) days after such expiry or termination.”

elements.element: Customer Data must be returned in a standard machine-readable format.
elements.evidence: The clause expressly requires return “in a standard machine-readable format.”

elements.element: Vendor must delete Customer Data after its return.
elements.evidence: After return, HDI must “delete such Content, user information and data from its systems.”

elements.element: Vendor must certify deletion to Customer after the data is returned and deleted.
elements.evidence: HDI must “certify such deletion in writing to the Company” after the return.

elements.element: The obligations apply upon expiry or termination of the agreement.
elements.evidence: The clause applies “[u]pon expiry or termination of this Agreement for any reason.”

elements.element: Vendor must provide transition assistance to Customer.
elements.evidence: HDI must “provide the Company with transition assistance.”

elements.element: Transition assistance must be available for at least 90 days.
elements.evidence: Assistance is available for up to six months, which exceeds and includes the acceptable 90-day fallback period.

elements.element: Vendor must export Customer Data to Customer.
elements.evidence: HDI must return the Company's Content, user information, and other Company data in a machine-readable format, satisfying the data-export requirement.

elements.element: The data export must occur within 30 days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: The return/export is required “within thirty (30) days after such expiry or termination.”

result.reason: The redline fully implements the preferred position and therefore also exceeds the fallback. It adds only relevant exit mechanics, preserves the existing termination and payment provisions, and introduces no contradiction. The clause clearly states the trigger, responsible party, assistance period and pricing, data-return deadline and format, deletion sequence, and written certification requirement.
